boundary: Exact triangle-surface intersections are checked on both pinned MyoSim source mesh geoms and source-owned ABI 3 NHBONES1 geometry after MyoSim/MuJoCo source equality projection. A crossing at a pose whose projected joint coordinates pass declared source and native ranges fails this sampled geometric gate. Source-mesh crossings locate a source pose/geometry problem that cannot be explained by BodyParts3D registration alone. Passing discrete samples does not prove a continuous motion envelope, closed-volume containment, cartilage contact, loaded patellar tracking, subject calibration, clinical anatomy, or whole-Human qualification.

equivalence_evidence.evidence_boundary: Static source and equality-projected pose equivalence only. This does not establish loaded knee contact, dynamic standing, clinical validity, or accepted runtime behavior.
equivalence_evidence.method: Recompiled pinned source before and after rebasing, projected the same eight neutral, limb-flexion, ankle, subtalar, MTP, deep-crouch, and functional-crouch coordinate sets through the original equality program, and compared all body transforms.

additional_source_overlays.evidence_boundary: The upstream archive remains immutable; the exact source-tree changes are reversible and hash-bound. The anteriority comparison uses the pinned source knee-anchor plane, not a clinical landmark standard.
